Flipped do not Un-Flip until the player is instructed to do so.
When a card is Flipped, you may no longer use the front of the
card. Instead, you reference the Item text, Icons, and Abilities
printed on the back of the card.
Disciplines cannot be used while Flipped. However, other types
of cards can. Weapons, Armor, Cores, and Relics will have Icons,
Symbols, and Ability text printed on their backs to remind players
that these cards can still be used once Flipped. Companion cards
and Familiars will also have Ability text printed on their backs.
